core_obligations: Define the map I^{tensor i} tensor H^i(F^bullet) -> H^i(eta_I F^bullet) by sending g tensor (class of s) to the class of gs, where s is a local section of the kernel of d^i and gs lies in (eta_I F)^i contained in I^i F (proof lines 14235-14249).
Verify that this assignment is well defined and independent of the chosen representative of the cohomology class (proof line 14250).

Show the induced map factors through an isomorphism I^{tensor i} tensor (H^i(F^bullet)/H^i(F^bullet)[I]) -> H^i(eta_I F^bullet) by checking on stalks, where it becomes the corresponding algebraic isomorphism (proof lines 14251-14254).
proof_roadmap: Write down the levelwise map from I^i tensored with the cycles of F^i to the cycles of eta_I F.
Check well-definedness and compatibility with the quotient by I-torsion.
Reduce the isomorphism claim to stalks and invoke the algebraic statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma provides a canonical isomorphism I^{tensor i} tensor (H^i(F^bullet)/H^i(F^bullet)[I]) -> H^i(eta_I F^bullet) for a complex of I-torsion free modules in the eta situation. The proof constructs the map explicitly on local sections: for a local section g of I^{tensor i} and a local section s of the kernel of d^i, the class of s is sent to the section gs of (eta_I F)^i inside I^i F, which is again a cycle and hence defines a class in H^i(eta_I F^bullet); well-definedness is checked directly (proof lines 14235-14250). The isomorphism claim is then verified on stalks, where it translates into the corresponding algebraic statement (proof lines 14251-14254). H2: the explicit section-level construction and the reduction to the algebraic model on stalks is the substance; the section-level map is not written down elsewhere.
